moments.text: Low-contrast colour view of broken, peach-tinted cloud against hazy blue-grey, no on-screen symbols. A tiny pale speck right of centre drifts left.
The speck holds still just above-left of centre while the clouds slide past to the right; the sensor is panning with it.
The speck slips down to just left of centre, then drifts further left.
The view swings left in jerks; the speck slides right across the frame and leaves past the right edge.
Only cloud remains in view until the clip ends.

notes: Speck is 2-3 px and very low contrast; needs a contrast boost to see. Muted colour-looking picture, no HUD.
